msg: The experiment told me that there is some level of skill involved. I tried to find a pattern, but I'm not sure that I did. Gnomes that I thought were good became bad and gnomes that I thought were bad became good. Perhaps there is a pattern, which changes towards the middle, then changes again? I'm not sure. You'll have to discover it for yourself. The advice that I was given by the person before me said that there wasn't a pattern.Other advice. Try to focus - you don't want to miss out on points by failing to press the keys on time.Take advantage of the breaks.I got a little over 3000 points - see if you can do better!Good Luck.
